ArtPlacer · Website templates

Eight website templates, with ArtPlacer built in

Two families of ready-to-use websites. Gallery Themes are full gallery sites with several artists, exhibitions, news and an Artworks sales page. Artist Themes are simpler sites for a single artist. Every artwork page carries the three ArtPlacer buttons, and exhibition pages can embed an ArtPlacer Virtual Exhibition.

Gallery Themes

4 templates

For galleries and art dealers: an artists roster with a page for each artist, gallery-wide exhibitions and news, and an Artworks page with a cart.

Artist Themes

4 templates

For individual artists: a simple site with Home, Bio, Artworks, Exhibitions, News and Contact. Each demo features one artist.

ArtPlacer widgets used

Installed as in ArtPlacer's Other Platforms guide (manual integration, HTML). The script code goes at the bottom of every template page, right before </body>:

<script src="https://widget.artplacer.com/js/script.js"></script>

In all eight templates, each artwork page (and each edition's product page in the Gallery Themes) carries three ArtPlacer button codes exactly as supplied. Only the "dynamic … here" placeholders are filled from the artwork on the page.

View in AR (type 3):

<artplacer gallery="9386" button_width="auto" default_wall_dimension="height" unit="in" type="3" bgcolor="#ffffff" bordercolor="#000000" fontcolor="#000000" artwork_url="dynamic url here" height="dynamic height here" title="dynamic title here" size="dynamic size here" price="dynamic price here" artist="dynamic artist name here"></artplacer>

Try in your room (type 1):

<artplacer gallery="9386" button_width="auto" dimensions_standard="hxw" default_wall_dimension="height" unit="in" type="1" resizable="true" frames="true" rotate="true" catalog="true" data_capture_form="false" bgcolor="#ffffff" bordercolor="#000000" fontcolor="#000000" artwork_url="dynamic url here" height="dynamic height here" title="dynamic title here" size="dynamic size here" price="dynamic price here" artist="dynamic artist name here"></artplacer>

View in a room (Sample Room, type 2):

<artplacer gallery="9386" default_style="true" button_width="auto" resizable="true" frames="true" rotate="true" dimensions_standard="hxw" default_wall_dimension="height" unit="in" catalog="true" data_capture_form="false" type="2" space="73591" additional_spaces="73591,136259,35727" artwork_url="dynamic url here" height="dynamic height here" title="dynamic title here" size="dynamic size here" price="dynamic price here" artist="dynamic artist name here"></artplacer>

ArtPlacer's buttons are styled to match each template through the .artplacer-button class in the template's stylesheet (with !important, since ArtPlacer sets inline styles). All three buttons share the template's outlined button style and the same size, so none looks selected when the page opens; a button fills in only while the mouse is over it. Pages change without a full reload, so ArtPlacer's ArtPlacer.reload() runs on each page change to pick up the new artwork.

Exhibition pages where Virtual Exhibition is enabled:

<iframe width="100%" height="450" src="https://d7mntklkfre1v.cloudfront.net/virtual-exhibitions/?i=22084" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Testing on this computer: double-click any template file. ArtPlacer's script opens its window at an address starting with //widget.artplacer.com, which a double-clicked file would turn into file://. When the page is opened as a file, it makes that address use https while the button is clicked. ArtPlacer's code is not changed.

Artwork images: ArtPlacer downloads each artwork from a public https link. On an https website the page's own img/works/ is used. On this computer the button uses the copies in the GitHub repository artplacer-templates (nicoicon22.github.io/artplacer-templates/img/works/).
